bio: Hidden behind the grand façade of this former courthouse are the Rosewood, a luxury hotel, and its restaurant, Eeuwen. Walk through the stately entrance and see how the dining space matches the elegance, opulence and stylish design of the rest of this meticulously restored building. Dutch artworks accentuate the serene mood. The courtyard terrace is stunning. Dutch ingredients are showcased on the plate, presented in a way that brings out their natural essence. Dishes also feature occasional exotic seasonings and sauces that pack a punch. Think barbecued langoustines with a delicate herb oil subtly infused with garlic, an intense langoustine bisque, crunchy peas and briny samphire. What's more, you can treat yourself here every day of the week – including for lunch!...
